draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Lonar! The lake here sits inside a crater made by a meteorite impact, and it's the only crater lake of meteoritic origin in India.
draft.hungryLine: For a proper meal, head to Gulmohar, about 10 minutes' walk from the MTDC resort, which serves food for all three meals.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Lonar Lake is a short drive from here, and around it you'll find the Daityasudan Surya temple, Gaimukh and the Motha Maruti temple.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Hang out on the rim of Lonar Lake before sunset and just take in the crater, it's breathtaking the first time.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The lake water has a pH of about 10.7, and even trees whose roots reach it die.

spots.name: Lonar Lake
spots.detail: Short drive · A soda lake in a 1.8 km wide, 150 m deep meteorite crater

spots.name: Gaimukh
spots.detail: Near the lake · A fresh water spring with old Peshwa-era masonry

spots.name: Daityasudan Surya temple
spots.detail: In Lonar · A small ruined temple in the Khajuraho style

legends.title: The magnetic rock
legends.body: This Hanuman temple is built around a magnetic rock. People say the rock was formed by the meteor's impact.

tips.title: Reach the lake before sunset.
tips.body: The crater is at its best in the late afternoon light.

tips.title: Don't touch the water.
tips.body: The lake is strongly alkaline and harmful, and the smell of hydrogen sulfide is common near the water.

story.title: Deccan basalt
story.body: Volcanic lava laid down the basalt of the Deccan Plateau here. That rock is what makes Lonar's crater so unusual.

story.title: The meteorite strikes
story.body: A hypervelocity meteorite hit the plateau and blasted out the crater. Some dating puts it much older, but that result is disputed.

story.title: Taming the spring
story.body: At Gaimukh, the Peshwas added masonry to channel a perennial fresh water spring. Temples like Kamalja Devi line the lake's edge.

story.title: A protected wetland
story.body: Lonar Lake was declared a Ramsar site and is also a National Geological Monument. The sanctuary around it covers 365 hectares of dry deciduous forest.

food.name: Gulmohar
food.detail: Clean, tasty food for breakfast, lunch and dinner

status.text: 10 min walk from the MTDC resort
